scenes.basis: 20:2 "he came into Greece"; 20:3 "When he had spent three months there" - the itinerary through Macedonia (20:1-2) is the approach leg; the three-month stay is in Greece

20:5 "But these had gone ahead, and were waiting for us at Troas"; 20:6 "We sailed away from Philippi after the days of Unleavened Bread, and came to them at Troas in five days, where we stayed seven days" - the companions of 20:4 are a list of origins, never settings

20:15 "Sailing from there, we came the following day opposite Chios. The next day we touched at Samos and stayed at Trogyllium, and the day after we came to Miletus" - the following scene (20:17) is at Miletus; sailing past Ephesus (20:16) is the leg
20:17 "From Miletus he sent to Ephesus, and called to himself the elders of the assembly"; 20:18 "When they had come to him, he said to them" - the speech is to Ephesian elders, spoken at Miletus
